events.why: UNVERIFIED, NEEDS CONSOLE: from 03.04's end outside the Pokemon Center (console B 2026-11-16) back in to the nurse. These legs are from inside the Center (turn right, walk into the counter that faces her; user, console B, 2026-11-13) and do not reach her from outside; the walk in from the door is not measured. not planned: Lumiose has no tile grid to plan a route target on; the walk ends on the A prompt it goes to.

the nurse heals the party (A takes a question's top answer), until control at the counter. Healing writes a save, so the title screen's Up + B + X backup save is this spot after the checkpoint's menu save (user, 2026-11-13). UNVERIFIED, NEEDS CONSOLE: the nurse's lines were not recorded.

metadata.source: added 2026-11-13 so Main Mission 03 has a backup save to retry from; no console recording of its steps: every step is unverified and needs console. It is not in the 2026-11-08 recording (03.04 is steps 53-55, 03.06 starts at step 56), and 03.04 now ends on the game's autosave outside the Center (console B 2026-11-16), which may already give Main Mission 03 the save to retry from: whether the heal is still needed is the user's call. Autosave: the heal's save was seen in a run log (2026-11-15 save review).
